name: Hronaut
description: Provides a visible local Chromium workspace for coding agents, preserving named tabs and sign-in state across MCP sessions with explicit human takeover for sensitive steps.

skills.name: Persistent Workspaces
skills.description: Keeps named tabs and browser storage available between agent sessions, repositories, and client reconnects.

skills.name: Human Takeover
skills.description: Pauses MCP work so a person can sign in, complete 2FA or CAPTCHA, and resume in the same visible browser.

skills.name: Browser Inspection
skills.description: Exposes bounded page, console, network, screenshot, download, and responsive-layout inspection for local QA workflows.
